glossUnihan: the active, male principle in Chinese philosophy (yang); light; sun
formNote: The Shuowen: 陽，高、明也 — “high and bright.” 昜 shows the sun above the horizon; with 阝, the sunlit slope. Mojidata IDS: ⿰阝昜.
summary: The sunny slope, the bright, the high: yang, the active half of the pair. The Xici defines the Way itself through it: 一陰一陽之謂道, one yin and one yang, that is the Way.
placement: Just above the centre, on the right, facing 陰. (Placement is a design choice, not a claim.)

oc.note: † Baracus, from general knowledge; not yet checked against B–S 2014.

satellites.title: High and Bright
satellites.evidence: The Shuowen: 陽，高、明也, “high and bright”. The phonetic 昜 pictures the sun risen over the horizon; the hill radical makes it the slope that catches the light.

satellites.title: One Yin, One Yang: That Is the Way
satellites.evidence: Xici, part one: 一陰一陽之謂道 — “one yin, one yang: this is called the Way.” Neither alone; their alternation.
